product_metadata.title: Ballcap Buddy - Original and Patented Hat Cleaner, Hat Washer for Washing Machine or Dishwasher, Cap Washer Frame for Flat & Curved Hats, Black, Made in USA
features: CLEANS CAPS SAFELY & QUICKLY - This hat washer for baseball caps effectively cleans your caps without deforming them. Cleaning, drying, storing, and protecting your cap is easier than ever with this cap cleaner – a hat cleaner for baseball caps that’s great for flat and curved hats too.

DURABLE & FLEXIBLE - Use it consistently for years! We crafted our patented baseball cap washer for washing machine, hat cage for washing machine from quality engineered polypropylene with optimal flexibility. Reinforced with firm construction, this baseball hat washer retains its shape.

DESIGNED FOR UNIVERSAL USE - Our one-sized ball cap washer for washing machine, baseball hat cleaner is suitable for kids or adult caps. You can also use this as a hat rack, baseball cap holder, hat hanger, and cap organizer at home or in a suitcase while traveling, to keep your hat in pristine condition.

WASHING MACHINE & DISHWASHER SAFE - Put 1 hat washing cage, cap washer for baseball caps in the washing machine one at a time. For safer hat wash, use the top rack of your dishwasher & avoid using a front-load/tumble-type washing machine. Do not put this cap cleaner for hats in the dryer.

EFFORTLESS LOCK & UNLOCK FEATURE - This ball cap washer for washing machine, hat holder for washing machine has a double-hook latch and snap hinge construction. Just push the latches into the center bar of this baseball hat washer cage using your thumb, fit your cap into position, then unlock after cleaning. Easy to use hat cleaner for washing machine!
